answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 49846 Country: India Title: Aqiqa Question: What are the obligations of aqiqa like age of slaughtering animal etc? Answer ID: 49846 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 161/118/D=02/1435) The conditions of aqiqah are just like Qurbani, e.g. goat of one year and buffalo of two years. The animal should be healthy, not blind, one-eyed and lame that may not walk on foot to the slaughtering place, etc. In short, an animal whose qurbani is lawful its aqiqah is also lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
